test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F is an immediate neighbour of A. D sits second to the right of E. B is an immediate neighbour of E and sits second to the right of C. F sits second to the right of D. A is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who sits to the immediate left of E?
solution: **Given :** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. **Explanation : ** 1) D sits second to the right of E. 2) B is an immediate neighbour of E and sits second to the right of C.
